{{Book}}


DSM-5-TR, known in full as ''The Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, Fifth Edition, Text Revision'', is the 2022 version of the official taxonomic and diagnostic guide published by the [[Collective:American_Psychiatric_Association|American Psychiatric Association (APA)]] for mental disorders, based on the 2013 version: DSM-5. 

== About the manual ==

=== Text Revision ===

APA chose to publish a text revision instead of a sixth version based on the living document principle.

== Intended audience ==

The manual states that it aims to provide a clear, concise, and standardised description of each mental disorder for:<ref>{{#cite:Q1713}}</ref> (p5)

* medical professionals,
* patients,
* family members of patients,
* researchers.

=== Warning on misuse ===

The manual warns against pronouncing diagnostics by the mechanical application of disorder descriptions.<ref>{{#cite:Q1713}}</ref> Clinical judgements by medical professionals are necessary for accurate diagnostics.<ref>{{#cite:Q1713}}</ref>

== Classification and organisation ==

The manual classifies the different mental disorders according to 11 criteria:<ref>{{#cite:Q1713}}</ref>

* neural substrates,
* familial traits,
* risk factors
  * genetic,
  * specific environmental,
* biological markers,
* temperamental antecedents,
* emotional or cognitive processing abnormalities,
* symptom similarity,
* course of the disorder,
* high comorbidity,
* shared treatment response.
